status: plan frozen; no fit, sample or score has been run under it
design_status: Retrospective model criticism on published duplicate means that have already informed earlier model development (v1, v2 and BAYES-001). Nothing here is blind, independent or a validation of biology.
question: Which explicit mechanism, added to the registry hydrolysis candidate, reduces the biomass/cellulose misfit found in BAYES-001 on whole-condition holdouts, and which of its parameters do these data identify?

data.replicates: duplicate means only; no raw replicates, no measured SD
data.glycerol_conditions: excluded: no hydrolysis, so they cannot discriminate the mechanisms below

baseline_provenance.misfit_evidence: BAYES-001: shared noise multiplier 2.25 [1.95, 2.63] at the assumed 10% error; the per-observable variant inflates biomass error 5.4x

shared_structure.error_model: Gaussian, SD = 0.1 x per-observable maximum over the three loadings, rho(biomass, substrate) = -0.5, temporal independence assumed, evidence assumed; one shared log-uniform noise multiplier in [0.1, 10] estimated with the parameters
shared_structure.priors: log-uniform between the declared bounds for every free parameter
shared_structure.initial_conditions: recorded t = 0 values per loading (biomass 0.3990672957214788 g/L, cellulose 10/20/30 g/L, activities 0), unchanged for every model

M0_baseline.mechanism: Registry hydrolysis candidate unchanged: consumption = k_h F S/(Kh+S) with explicit yield split; first-order biomass loss; activities produced qX S/(K_ind+S) and lost first-order.
M0_baseline.composition: existing case template trichoderma_harzianum_p49p11 (six generic processes)
M0_baseline.known_defect: growth cannot start before filter-paper activity appears (dX/dt(0) = -kd X0) although biomass rises by 8 h

M1_induction_state.mechanism: Enzyme synthesis follows an induced-biomass state z instead of instantaneous biomass: dz/dt = X S/(K_ind+S) - kz_loss z; dF/dt = qF z - kF F; dB/dt = qB z - kB B. Everything else as M0.
M1_induction_state.composition: proportional_synthesis (producer biomass, inducer substrate, product induced_pool) + first_order loss of induced_pool + two proportional_synthesis processes with producer induced_pool and no inducer

fixed_parameters.reason: the scale of z is not separately identifiable from qF and qB; z is defined as induced biomass equivalent

parameters.meaning: memory time constant of the induced state; small values delay and smooth activity production

M1_induction_state.expected_symmetries: kz_loss trades against qF and qB when the induction phase is short relative to sampling

M2_soluble_product_pool.mechanism: Hydrolysis releases a soluble product pool P that is taken up by Monod growth and inhibits hydrolysis: consumption = k_h F S/(Kh+S) / (1 + P/Ki) -> P; uptake = (mu/Y) X P/(Ks+P) -> Y X + (1-Y) ledger; P(0) = P0 stands for soluble carbon carried in by inoculum and medium and is not measured. Biomass loss and activity production as M0 (induction by cellulose S).
M2_soluble_product_pool.composition: homogeneous_michaelis_menten (enzyme-explicit, product soluble_product, product_inhibition modifier) + homogeneous_michaelis_menten (enzyme-explicit with biomass as the catalyst state, substrate soluble_product, yield product map) + the M0 loss and synthesis processes

parameters.meaning: Monod growth on the soluble pool
Monod half-saturation of the soluble pool
soluble product inhibition of hydrolysis; the upper bound makes inhibition negligible
unmeasured initial soluble carbon; an explicit unknown, not a measured initial condition

M2_soluble_product_pool.expected_symmetries: mu and Ks are jointly constrained only while P is near Ks; P0 trades against mu for the first 8 h; Ki is bounded below only if hydrolysis never saturates in P
M2_soluble_product_pool.template_note: requires a new exploratory case template variant with a soluble_product state; the registry fungus record is unchanged

M3_conversion_dependent_accessibility.mechanism: Hydrolysis slows with conversion independent of enzyme activity: consumption = k_h F S/(Kh+S) (S/S0)^n, the substrate reactivity factor of Kadam, Rydholm and McMillan (2004, Biotechnol. Prog. 20:698-705, doi:10.1021/bp034316x) generalised by an exponent. Everything else as M0.
M3_conversion_dependent_accessibility.composition: M0 plus a generic conversion-reactivity rate modifier on the hydrolysis process

parameters.meaning: n = 1 is the Kadam form; n -> 0 recovers M0

M3_conversion_dependent_accessibility.new_code: one generic rate modifier (reactivity = (S/S0)^n) with provenance, a non-cellulose test case, and compiled-core kernel; implemented only after this plan is frozen and before any fit

excluded_mechanisms.maintenance: a Pirt maintenance term needs the soluble pool of M2 to draw from; it is deferred to a follow-up plan rather than mixed into M2 so that M2 tests one addition
excluded_mechanisms.published_gelain_equations: already compared in v2 (20 parameters, rank 19/20); not a mechanism addition
excluded_mechanisms.oxygen_nutrient_pH_morphology: not represented and not measured in the deposit

stage_A_least_squares.purpose: whole-condition holdout comparison and complexity screen, as in v2
stage_A_least_squares.folds: each cellulose loading held out once, training on the other two (3 folds per model) plus one all-condition fit per model
stage_A_least_squares.profiles: nuisance-reoptimised profile loss at fitted value x {0.5, 1, 2} for every parameter of every model that passes the screen

stage_B_posterior.purpose: adequacy, identifiability and posterior predictive coverage on all three loadings
stage_B_posterior.runs: one all-condition posterior per model (M0 may reuse BAYES-001's frozen chain)
stage_B_posterior.convergence_rule: every autocorrelation time reliable (chain > 50 tau) and every ESS >= 100; a chain that misses it is reported as not converged and its verdicts are labelled provisional

posterior_predictive.coverage: fraction of the 96 observations inside the 5-95% band with the estimated measurement noise included

stage_B_posterior.holdout_posteriors: only for models that pass the stage A screen, one posterior per fold; skipped with a stated reason if the compute cap is hit
stage_B_posterior.compute_cap: 2 h wall-clock per chain on the development container; chains are checkpointed and resumable

decision_rules.R1_holdout_support: passes the stage A screen against M0 in the primary scenario
decision_rules.R2_adequacy: the 95% interval of the shared noise multiplier contains 1.0 (adequate at the assumed 10% error); otherwise report the multiplier as the inadequacy factor
decision_rules.R3_identification: every added parameter is classified identified or weakly identified; a mechanism whose added parameters are all bounded on one side only or prior dominated is 'improves fit but unidentified' even if R1 passes
outcome_vocabulary: improves fit but unidentified (R1, not R3)
decision_rules.ties: if two mechanisms are supported, the one with fewer added parameters is preferred; both are reported

per_model: holdout normalized MSE per observable and pooled
claims_excluded: transfer to other strains, substrates or conditions
promotion of any constant beyond retrospective fit

amendment_rule: any change to this file after freezing is a dated entry in 'amendments' with its reason, recorded before the affected fit is run; the ledger records the file's sha256 at freezing and after each amendment
